name: Business in Auberdine
summary: Borgus Steelhand seeks news of his brother Gorbold in Auberdine. The dwarven merchant asks travelers sailing west to check on Gorbold, who recently began trading in the night elven port. Their route links Stormwind Harbor with the shores of northern Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Dwarf Far from Home
sections.body: Borgus Steelhand trusts his family's name among traders. His brother, Gorbold Steelhand, crossed the Great Sea recently to work a merchant stall in Auberdine. Gorbold hoped to profit by supplying ships that call at Darkshore. Weeks have passed without a word, and Borgus worries about how his brother fares so far from Ironforge and Stormwind.

sections.title: The Harbor Passage
sections.body: Travel from the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor once meant a winding passage through Menethil Harbor or neutral goblin ports such as Booty Bay. Borgus directs travelers to a vessel at the southern-most dock of Stormwind Harbor. It sails directly to Auberdine's long wooden piers.

faq.answer: Borgus Steelhand is a dwarven merchant in Stormwind. He trusts his family's reputation for fair trading and seeks travelers to carry word to his brother Gorbold across the sea.
Gorbold Steelhand is in Auberdine, the main port settlement in Darkshore on Kalimdor's northwest coast. He works at a merchant stall serving arriving ships.

faq.q: How do you reach Auberdine from Stormwind?
aliases: how to get to darkshore from stormwind
faq.answer: A ship sails from the southern-most pier in Stormwind Harbor across the Great Sea to Auberdine's docks in Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is Borgus worried about his brother?
faq.answer: Gorbold left weeks ago to join a merchant stall in Auberdine, hoping to profit by supplying ships. He has sent no word home, so Borgus asks travelers to find out how he fares.

faq.q: What kind of settlement is Auberdine?
faq.answer: Auberdine is a coastal settlement in Darkshore, built and inhabited mainly by night elves. It is the Alliance's main shipping hub and ferry crossing between northern Kalimdor and Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the Steelhand family known for?
faq.answer: The Steelhand family is known for trade and for claiming to offer fair deals to travelers and dockworkers.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can find dwarven merchants such as the Steelhands trading far beyond the Khaz Modan mountains, even in the night elves' quiet, shadowed settlements.
As an Alliance traveler, you can sail directly between Stormwind Harbor and Auberdine, linking the human kingdom with the Kaldorei lands of northern Kalimdor.
